summary: Happy City Holdings Ltd, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing the resignation of independent director Mr. Yiu Wai Ming effective that date. The resignation was voluntary due to other professional commitments, with no disagreement or dispute with the company. Board composition remains compliant with Nasdaq listing rules, with three independent directors and committees intact. Mr. Kwok Ho Pan assumes compensation committee chairmanship. This is a routine board change, not a management departure requiring classification.
